Workflow

By-laws and the rules register

By-law parameters, mechanisms and thresholds are versioned data per entity. Where the text is silent the platform refuses by citation and routes the question to a named committee.

Built in the Hub
Built The ruleset workbench, overrides, parameters and refusals by citation are built. Ratifying the four-amendment package is a convention-floor matter, not build work.
Branches
All branches
Shared services
Membership and standing
Governed by
D4 · D5 · D41 · R40

Steps

  1. Upload a governing document and draft its rulesetConstitution Committee or federation staff
  2. Verify the extraction blind to the draft, then ratify with a person and a dateVerifier; ratifying body
  3. Set a parameter with its authority; rows are never edited in placeHolder of rules:set
  4. Carry overrides per entity lineage, and phantom rules visibly inactivePlatform
  5. Flag silent or ambiguous text OPEN and route it to the named committee (R40)Platform; named committee

Hands off to

  • rules → voting: apportionment, quorum and thresholds become configuration
  • rules → dues: the dues schedule is versioned; pricing before a schedule exists refuses

Programmes that use it

All, through the shared services.

Open

  • Four of the six "who counts as family" questions under By-Law 4.1.1 are unanswered.
  • Board Rules & Regulations (the dues-ladder authority) are not on file.
